entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A powerful, bestial witch of Eldraine who enchants victims with song and was killed by Kellan.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: Witch, sister of Agatha; helped cast the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: Witch, sister of Agatha; helped cast the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: Faerie who cast the Wicked Slumber with the witches and gave Agatha the Vile Cauldron.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Spell cast to end the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion ended by the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Vile Cauldron
entities.description: Cauldron that boils down the essence of those within.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Woodsman enchanted by Agatha into the Wolf Knight.

entities.name: Syr Imodane
entities.description: Captured by Agatha and Peter, nearly cooked in a stew.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Slew Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron.

events.summary: Agatha, Eriette and Hylda help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion; Talion gives Agatha the Vile Cauldron.
events.quote: helped the faerie Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Agatha begins influencing forest animals from her cabin near Dunbarrow.
events.quote: turning them more vicious and carnivorous

events.summary: Agatha enchants the woodsman Peter into the Wolf Knight.
events.quote: she enchanted the woodsman Peter , turning him into the Wolf Knight

events.summary: With Peter's help Agatha captures Syr Imodane and prepares to cook her.
events.quote: she captured Syr Imodane and prepared to cook her into a stew

events.summary: Kellan kills Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron.
events.quote: Kellan slew the witch by pushing her into her cauldron and boiling her alive.
